title: CTF Atlas — Ethical Crawler Safety & Content Moderation Policy
description: Rules, allowed sources, and blocked keywords enforcing ethical cybersecurity training. Rejects weaponized malware, ransomware, destructive wipers, and unauthorized credential dumps.

policy.scope: Educational Capture-The-Flag (CTF) training, defensive engineering, and authorized security research.
policy.strict_rule: Under no circumstances should weaponized malware binaries, destructive wiper payloads, ransomware kits, unauthorized credentials, or illegal carding material be indexed.

allowed_sources.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Defensive catalog providing authoritative patch deadlines for enterprise defenders.

allowed_sources.name: NIST National Vulnerability Database
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Standardized CVE identification and CVSS severity metrics.

allowed_sources.name: GTFOBins Unix Binary Security Research
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Curated Unix binary permission configuration guidance for systems hardening.

allowed_sources.name: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei Vulnerability Templates
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Community vulnerability detection signatures for asset discovery.

allowed_sources.name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series Releases
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Authoritative enterprise defensive guidance and architecture patterns.

allowed_sources.name: Bug Bounty Public Disclosures & Writeups
allowed_sources.ethical_mandate: Responsible disclosure writeups demonstrating triage and remediation.
